The '''Lambda sector''' was a sector in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], neighboring the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]].<ref name="HNNnote">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|regional/1344_2.html|Shots Fired in Andoan Space}} This is based on Rintonne neighboring Ando.</ref> Planets in Lambda included [[Rintonne/Legends|Rintonne]] and [[Xandil VII]], as well as a number of heavy industrial worlds and ship construction centers.<ref name="WBC" />

==History==
Around [[3624 BBY]] the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter faction known as the [[Hidden Chain]] [[Hidden Chain raids|raided]] a three-planet system in the Lambda sector. [[Jekiah Ordo]], who was commanding Mandalorian [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|loyalist]] forces in [[Mandalore the Avenger]]s stead, dispatched [[Galaar Squad (Mandalorians)|Galaar Squad]] to deal with the traitors.<ref name="TOR:RtN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Road to Nowhere|[[Port Nowhere]]}}</ref>

Between [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]] and [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], the sector was the site of the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

The Lambda sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Rasit Brun]] at the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN" /> The sector split in two during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The systems located along the two major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="TEA" />

Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Par Lankin]].<ref name="WBC" /> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Lambda sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" /> However, Moff Lankin became one of the many Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], keeping the sector under control<ref name="SWAJ2" /> and making [[Rintonne/Legends|Rintonne]] his [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] crossed the Lambda sector, [[Battle of Mon Gazza (Nagai invasion)|defeating]] Moff Lankin's forces on their way.<ref name="TEA" />

The sector was liberated when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] defeated warlord Par Lankin in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="WBC" />

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Battle of Ando (Thrawn campaign)|reconquered]] all the systems located along the two major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] of the sector, including the planets [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], the [[Algaran system]], and astronomical object [[Thape]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], only a small part of the Lambda sector was [[Invasion of Ando (Yuuzhan Vong War)|invaded]].<ref name="TEA" />
